class: A JSON-returning model call had no retry when the reply parsed as the wrong type, or failed to parse at all -- unlike plan_page, which already asks again on a reply cut off mid-JSON
symptom: No live incident yet -- found auditing the Q&A answering engine before extending it. answer_screening_questions crashes with AttributeError ("'list' object has no attribute 'items'") if a model replies with a JSON array instead of an object; choose_option, answer_single_question, and read_page each propagated a malformed-JSON ClaudeIntegrationError on the first bad parse with zero retries, unlike plan_page's existing cut-off-reply recovery.
site: Not site-specific -- shared answering engine (claude_integration.py, used by both Claude and Gemini via gemini_integration.py's shared ClaudeClient base) that answers every ATS portal's screening questions, dropdown choices, and single-question fallbacks.
root_cause: plan_page (the one JSON-returning method in this class with a retry loop) wraps its own self._client.messages.create() call and its own _extract_json() parse inside the same for-attempt loop, so a reply that doesn't parse triggers another attempt. answer_screening_questions, choose_option, and answer_single_question instead called self._call() once (which only retries transport errors: rate limits, connection failures) and then self._extract_json() separately, outside any retry boundary -- so a parse failure, or a reply of the wrong top-level type, propagated immediately. read_page had its own retry loop but its final 'except Exception: break' caught ClaudeIntegrationError too and gave up on the first attempt instead of retrying it.
why_tests_missed: Every existing test for these methods scripted a well-formed reply; nothing exercised a model returning a differently-shaped or unparseable JSON body for anything other than plan_page, so the asymmetry between plan_page's retry and the other methods' lack of one was never visible to the test suite.
fix: Added ClaudeClient._call_json() (claude_integration.py): retries self._call() + self._extract_json() together, up to JSON_SHAPE_RETRIES (a fixed constant, independent of self._config.claude_max_retries so it still works against the bare ClaudeClient test doubles several existing tests construct with object.__new__), escalating only after exhausting that budget, with the same 'answer again with ONLY JSON' repair hint plan_page already uses. answer_screening_questions, choose_option, and answer_single_question now call it instead of self._call()+self._extract_json(). read_page's own loop now also retries on ClaudeIntegrationError instead of breaking on it, and checks its parsed reply is a dict before indexing it (logged via logger.debug per test_no_silent_handlers.py).
prevention: Every JSON-returning model call goes through ClaudeClient._call_json() (or inherits read_page/plan_page's own equivalent loop) rather than a bare self._call() + self._extract_json(); a new JSON-returning method that skips it is the same class of gap recurring.
